verses.original: Ὅλως ἀκούεται ἐν ὑμῖν πορνεία καὶ τοιαύτη πορνεία ἥτις οὐδὲ ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ὥστε γυναῖκά τινα τοῦ πατρὸς ἔχειν
verses.transliteration: Holōs akouetai en hymin porneia kai toiautē porneia hētis oude en tois ethnesin hōste gynaika tina tou patros echein
verses.literal: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you and of a kind that is . . . intolerable even among pagans A man has his father’s wife
verses.literalPt: Consta, geralmente, que há fornicação entre vós e tal fornicação qual nem ainda entre os gentios, de modo que há quem vive com a mulher de seu pai.

verses.original: καὶ ὑμεῖς πεφυσιωμένοι ἐστέ καὶ οὐχὶ μᾶλλον ἐπενθήσατε ἵνα ἀρθῇ ἐκ μέσου ὑμῶν ὁ τὸ ἔργον τοῦτο πράξας
verses.transliteration: kai hymeis pephysiōmenoi este kai ouchi mallon epenthēsate hina arthē ek mesou hymōn ho to ergon touto praxas
verses.literal: And you are proud Shouldn’t you rather have been stricken with grief and have removed from your fellowship the man who did this . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Estais vós inchados e não pranteastes, para que fosse tirado do meio de vós aquele que tal ação praticou?

verses.original: Ἐγὼ μὲν γάρ ἀπὼν τῷ σώματι παρὼν δὲ τῷ πνεύματι ἤδη κέκρικα ὡς παρὼν τὸν οὕτως τοῦτο κατεργασάμενον
verses.transliteration: Egō men gar apōn tō sōmati parōn de tō pneumati ēdē kekrika hōs parōn ton houtōs touto katergasamenon
verses.literal: Although I am absent from you in body I am present with you in spirit and I have already pronounced judgment on the one who did this just as if I were present
verses.literalPt: Pois eu, na verdade, ausente em corpo, mas presente em espírito, já tenho, como se estivesse presente, julgado aquele que assim se portou:

verses.original: ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ συναχθέντων ὑμῶν καὶ τοῦ ἐμοῦ πνεύματος σὺν τῇ δυνάμει τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: en tō onomati tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou synachthentōn hymōn kai tou emou pneumatos syn tē dynamei tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou
verses.literal: When you are assembled in the name of our Lord Jesus and I am with you in spirit along with the power of the Lord Jesus
verses.literalPt: em nome do Senhor Jesus, congregados vós e o meu espírito, com o poder de nosso Senhor Jesus,

verses.original: παραδοῦναι τὸν τοιοῦτον τῷ Σατανᾷ εἰς ὄλεθρον τῆς σαρκός ἵνα τὸ πνεῦμα σωθῇ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: paradounai ton toiouton tō Satana eis olethron tēs sarkos hina to pneuma sōthē en tē hēmera tou Kyriou
verses.literal: hand this man over to Satan for the destruction of the flesh so that his spirit may be saved on the Day of the Lord
verses.literalPt: seja o tal entregue a Satanás, para a destruição da carne, a fim de que o espírito seja salvo no Dia do Senhor.

verses.original: Οὐ καλὸν τὸ καύχημα ὑμῶν οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι μικρὰ ζύμη ὅλον τὸ φύραμα ζυμοῖ
verses.transliteration: Ou kalon to kauchēma hymōn ouk oidate hoti mikra zymē holon to phyrama zymoi
verses.literal: Your boasting is not good Do you not know that a little leaven works through the whole batch of dough
verses.literalPt: Não é boa a vossa jactância. Não sabeis que um pouco de fermento leveda a massa toda?

verses.original: ἐκκαθάρατε τὴν παλαιὰν ζύμην ἵνα ἦτε νέον φύραμα καθώς ἐστε ἄζυμοι καὶ γὰρ τὸ πάσχα ἡμῶν ἐτύθη Χριστός
verses.transliteration: ekkatharate tēn palaian zymēn hina ēte neon phyrama kathōs este azymoi kai gar to pascha hēmōn etythē Christos
verses.literal: Get rid of the old leaven that you may be a new unleavened batch as you really are For Christ our Passover lamb has been sacrificed
verses.literalPt: Purificai o velho fermento, para que sejais uma nova massa, assim como sois sem fermento. Pois, na verdade, Cristo, que é nossa páscoa, foi imolado.

verses.original: ὥστε ἑορτάζωμεν μὴ ἐν ζύμῃ παλαιᾷ μηδὲ ἐν ζύμῃ κακίας καὶ πονηρίας ἀλλ’ ἐν ἀζύμοις εἰλικρινείας καὶ ἀληθείας
verses.transliteration: hōste heortazōmen mē en zymē palaia mēde en zymē kakias kai ponērias all’ en azymois eilikrineias kai alētheias
verses.literal: Therefore let us keep the feast not with the old bread, leavened . . . . . . . . . with malice and wickedness but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and of truth
verses.literalPt: Por isso, celebremos a festa não com o velho fermento, nem com o fermento da maldade e da malícia, mas com os asmos da sinceridade e da verdade.

verses.original: Ἔγραψα ὑμῖν ἐν τῇ ἐπιστολῇ μὴ συναναμίγνυσθαι πόρνοις
verses.transliteration: Egrapsa hymin en tē epistolē mē synanamignysthai pornois
verses.literal: I wrote you in my letter not to associate with sexually immoral people
verses.literalPt: Na minha carta, vos escrevi que não vos comunicásseis com os fornicários,

verses.original: οὐ πάντως τοῖς πόρνοις τοῦ κόσμου τούτου ἢ τοῖς πλεονέκταις καὶ ἅρπαξιν ἢ εἰδωλολάτραις ἐπεὶ ὠφείλετε ἄρα ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ἐξελθεῖν
verses.transliteration: ou pantōs tois pornois tou kosmou toutou ē tois pleonektais kai harpaxin ē eidōlolatrais epei ōpheilete ara ek tou kosmou exelthein
verses.literal: I was not including the sexually immoral of this world or the greedy and swindlers or idolaters In that case you would have to leave . . . this world
verses.literalPt: não significando, de modo algum, os fornicários deste mundo, ou os avarentos e roubadores, ou os idólatras, pois, nesse caso, haveríeis de sair do mundo.

verses.original: νῦν δὲ ἔγραψα ὑμῖν μὴ συναναμίγνυσθαι ἐάν τις ἀδελφὸς ὀνομαζόμενος ᾖ πόρνος ἢ πλεονέκτης ἢ εἰδωλολάτρης ἢ λοίδορος ἢ μέθυσος ἢ ἅρπαξ τῷ τοιούτῳ μηδὲ συνεσθίειν
verses.transliteration: nyn de egrapsa hymin mē synanamignysthai ean tis adelphos onomazomenos ē pornos ē pleonektēs ē eidōlolatrēs ē loidoros ē methysos ē harpax tō toioutō mēde synesthiein
verses.literal: But now I am writing you not to associate with anyone who claims to be a brother but is sexually immoral or greedy an idolater or a verbal abuser a drunkard or a swindler With such a man do not even eat
verses.literalPt: Mas, sendo assim, vos escrevi que não comuniqueis com alguém que se chama vosso irmão, se for ele fornicário, ou avarento, ou idólatra, ou maldizente, ou bêbedo, ou roubador; com esse tal nem sequer comais.

verses.original: Τί γάρ μοι τοὺς ἔξω κρίνειν οὐχὶ τοὺς ἔσω ὑμεῖς κρίνετε
verses.transliteration: Ti gar moi tous exō krinein ouchi tous esō hymeis krinete
verses.literal: What business of mine is it to judge those outside the church Are you not to judge those inside
verses.literalPt: Pois que me vai a mim me julgar os que estão de fora? Não julgais vós os que estão de dentro?

verses.original: τοὺς δὲ ἔξω ὁ Θεὸς κρίνει Ἐξάρατε τὸν πονηρὸν ἐξ ὑμῶν αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: tous de exō ho Theos krinei Exarate ton ponēron ex hymōn autōn
verses.literal: God will judge those outside Expel the wicked man from among you . . .
verses.literalPt: Os de fora, porém, Deus os julgará. Tirai esse iníquo do meio de vós.
